source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 27ης Μαρτίου — «Όσιος Παύλος Επίσκοπος Κορίνθου»

attestations.note: The page gives him no years at all: born at Constantinople of pious parents who themselves took the monastic life, brother of St Peter, bishop of Argos, whose memory it puts on 3 May, an ascetic with his brother at Corinth, afterwards elected bishop of Corinth, fallen asleep in peace. It prints a couplet on the brotherhood and no hymn. The corpus holds no folder for Peter of Argos, so the brother is named in the life without a link.
